# 2. svydesignオブジェクト作成準備

```{r}
# ================================================================================
# 2. sampling weightの年次補正
# ================================================================================
# 年ごとの元 v005 合計を算出
year_totals <- df_lasso %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(total_v005 = sum(v005, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Survey designオブジェクトの作成前に変数を変換
df_lasso <- df_lasso %>%
  mutate(
    v021 = as.numeric(v021),                        # Primary Sampling Unit
    v022 = as.character(haven::as_factor(v022))    #haven_labelledをfactorに変換してからcharacter
  )

# 正規化済みサンプリングウェイトの作成
df_lasso <- df_lasso %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("total_v005"))) %>% # 存在する場合のみ削除
  left_join(year_totals, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(
    # 元のDHSウェイト
    dhs_weight = v005 / 1e6,
    # 年次正規化係数：全期間対象の標本サイズ比 (例：年の全体ウェイト比)
    year_norm = total_v005 / sum(year_totals$total_v005),
    # 正規化済みウェイト
    sampling_weight_norm = dhs_weight / year_norm,
    # 極端値トリミング
    sampling_weight_trimmed = pmax(
      pmin(sampling_weight_norm,
           quantile(sampling_weight_norm, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)),
      quantile(sampling_weight_norm, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

# 元データのラベル適正化
library(labelled)

# 1. 元のhaven_labelledデータから変換
df_lasso <- df_lasso %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.labelled), labelled::to_factor))

# ================================================================================
# 3. surveydesignオブジェクトの作成
# ================================================================================
library(survey)
library(glmnet)

# Survey designオブジェクトの作成
svy_design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~v021,          # Primary Sampling Unit (クラスター)
  strata = ~v022,       # 層化変数
  weights = ~sampling_weight_trimmed,
  data = df_lasso,
  nest = TRUE           # 入れ子構造
)

# 孤立PSUの処理
options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")
print("Survey designオブジェクトが作成されました")

# Survey designオブジェクトを保存
saveRDS(svy_design,
        file.path(save_path, "svy_design_lasso_IV_org.rds")
)

# 後で使うラベル一覧を取得
# var_label()で一度に全ラベルを取得
all_labels <- var_label(svy_design$variables)
# データフレームに変換
label_df <- data.frame(
  variable_name = names(all_labels),
  label = as.character(all_labels)
)


```


# 3. 各種関数

```{r}
library(survey)

# *******************************************************************************
# IV-GLM関数定義
#' @title survey_2sls
#' @description survey-weighted 2SLS回帰を実行する関数
#' @param y1 内生変数
#' @param y2 目的変数
#' @param instrument 操作変数
#' @param covariates 共変量ベクトル
#' *******************************************************************************
survey_2sls <- function(y1, y2, instrument, covariates, design) {
  data <- design$variables
  
  # 1st stage: y1（内生変数）を instrument（操作変数）+ 共変量で予測
  formula_1st <- as.formula(
    paste(y1, " ~ ", instrument, " + ", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))
  print("1st stageの式:")
  print(formula_1st)
  
  formula_2nd <- as.formula(
    paste(y2, " ~ ", paste(c("pred_y1", covariates), collapse = " + "))
  )
  print("2nd stageの式:")
  print(formula_2nd)

  # survey-weighted 1st stage regression
  # 家計消費変数がダミー変数かどうかを判定してgaussian()を使うか決定
  if (is_dummy(data[[y1]])) {
    cat(paste("y1:", y1, "はダミー変数です。ロジスティック回帰を使用します。\n"))
    family_1st <- binomial(link = "logit")
    
    # y1がfactor型の場合、数値型に変換
    if (is.factor(data[[y1]])) {
      cat(paste("y1:", y1, "はfactor型です。数値型に変換します。\n"))
    
      # factor のレベルを確認
      levels_y1 <- levels(data[[y1]])
      cat(paste("レベル数:", length(levels_y1), "\n"))
      cat("レベル:", paste(levels_y1, collapse = ", "), "\n")
      
      # 適切な変換方法を選択
      if (all(levels_y1 %in% c("0", "1"))) {
        # レベルが "0" と "1" の場合
        design$variables[[y1]] <- as.numeric(as.character(design$variables[[y1]]))
        cat("文字列 '0'/'1' を数値に変換しました。\n")
        
      } else if (length(levels_y1) == 2) {
        # レベルが2つだが "0"/"1" でない場合（例: "No"/"Yes"）
        design$variables[[y1]] <- as.numeric(design$variables[[y1]]) - 1
        cat(paste("2レベルfactorを 0/1 に変換しました:", levels_y1[1], "→ 0,", 
                  levels_y1[2], "→ 1\n"))
      }
    }  # <- is.factor()のif文の閉じ括弧
  } else {  # <- is_dummy()のelse
    family_1st <- gaussian()
  }  # <- is_dummy()のif文の閉じ括弧
  
  # -------------------------------------
  # 1st stage回帰モデルの適合
  # -------------------------------------
  fit1_svy <- svyglm(formula_1st, design = design, family = family_1st)

  # 予測値を元のデータフレームに保存
  pred_y1_raw <- predict(fit1_svy, type = "response")

  # *** 重要：予測値を標準化・スケーリング ***
  pred_mean <- mean(pred_y1_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
  pred_sd <- sd(pred_y1_raw, na.rm = TRUE)

  # スケーリング（重要な処理）
  data[["pred_y1"]] <- (pred_y1_raw - pred_mean) / pred_sd
  
  # Survey designオブジェクトを再作成
  svy_design <- svydesign(
    ids = ~v021,
    strata = ~v022,
    weights = ~sampling_weight_trimmed,
    data = data,
    nest = TRUE
  )
  
  print("Survey designオブジェクトを再作成しました")
  
  # -------------------------------------
  # 2nd stage
  # -------------------------------------
  fit2_svy <- svyglm(formula_2nd, design = svy_design, family = quasibinomial())
  

  return(list(
    fit1_svy = fit1_svy,
    fit2_svy = fit2_svy,
    pred_sd = pred_sd
  ))
}

# ---- 関数ここまで ------------------------------------------------------------
# *******************************************************************************
# p値から有意水準を取得する関数
# '  @title get_significance
# '  @description p値から有意水準を取得する関数
# '  @param p_value p値
# '  @return 有意水準の文字列
# *******************************************************************************
get_significance <- function(p_value) {
  if (is.na(p_value)) return("")
  else if (p_value < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p_value < 0.01) return("**")
  else if (p_value < 0.05) return("*")
  else if (p_value < 0.10) return(".")
  else return("")
}
# ---- 関数ここまで ------------------------------------------------------------
# ================================================================================
# @title create_table1
# @description 回帰結果を表形式でまとめる関数
# @param fit1_svy 1st stageのsvyglmオブジェクト
# @param fit2_svy 2nd stageのsvyglmオブジェクト
# @return データフレーム形式の結果表
# ================================================================================
create_table1 <- function(fit1_svy, fit2_svy, label_df = NULL) {
  # すべての係数情報をまとめて取得（最も効率的）
  coef_table_1st <- summary(fit1_svy)$coefficients
  coef_table_2nd <- summary(fit2_svy)$coefficients
  
  # 目的変数名を取得
  y1 <- as.character(formula(fit1_svy)[[2]])
  
  # 全変数に適用
  p_values_1st <- coef_table_1st[, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  significance_1st <- sapply(p_values_1st, get_significance)
  p_values_2nd <- coef_table_2nd[, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  significance_2nd <- sapply(p_values_2nd, get_significance)
  
  # 95%信頼区間を取得
  ci_1st <- confint(fit1_svy, level = 0.95)
  ci_2nd <- confint(fit2_svy, level = 0.95)
  
  # 操作変数のt値からF統計量を計算
  instrument_name <- "juntos_non_participation"
  t_value_1st <- coef_table_1st[instrument_name, "t value"]
  f_stat <- t_value_1st^2
  
  
  # F > 10 で操作変数が「十分に強い」と判定
  
  # First-stage結果をまとめる
  first_stage_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = rownames(coef_table_1st),
    Coefficient = coef_table_1st[, "Estimate"],
    SE = coef_table_1st[, "Std. Error"],
    Significance = significance_1st,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      # 係数と有意性マークを結合
      Display_Coef = paste0(sprintf("%.4f", Coefficient), Significance),
      # 標準誤差を括弧内に
      Display_SE = paste0("(", sprintf("%.4f", SE), ")")
    ) %>%
    select(Variable, Display_Coef, Display_SE)
  
  # First-stage特有の情報を行として追加
  additional_stats <- data.frame(
    Variable = c("F-statistic", "N"),
    Display_Coef = c(
      paste0(sprintf("%.2f", f_stat), "***"),
      sprintf("%.0f", nobs(fit1_svy))
    ),
    Display_SE = c("", ""),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  first_stage_df <- rbind(first_stage_df, additional_stats)
  
  # SEcond-stage結果をまとめる
  second_stage_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = rownames(coef_table_2nd),
    Coefficient = coef_table_2nd[, "Estimate"],
    SE = coef_table_2nd[, "Std. Error"],
    Significance = significance_1st,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      # pred_y1をy1の名前に置換
      Variable = ifelse(Variable == "pred_y1", y1, Variable)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # 係数と有意性マークを結合
      Display_Coef = paste0(sprintf("%.4f", Coefficient), Significance),
      # 標準誤差を括弧内に
      Display_SE = paste0("(", sprintf("%.4f", SE), ")")
    ) %>%
    select(Variable, Display_Coef, Display_SE)
  
  # First-stage と Second-stage を区別するため Panel 列を追加
  first_stage_df <- first_stage_df %>%
    mutate(Panel = "Panel A: First-Stage")
  
  second_stage_df <- second_stage_df %>%
    mutate(Panel = "Panel B: Second-Stage")
  
  # 結合
  table1_data <- rbind(first_stage_df, second_stage_df)

  # 変数ラベルが提供されていれば、Variable名をラベルに置換
  if (!is.null(label_df)) {

    # label_dfのクリーニング
    label_lookup <- label_df %>%
      select(variable_name, label) %>%
      mutate(
        label = as.character(label),
        label = na_if(label, "NULL"),  # "NULL"文字列をNAに
        label = if_else(label == "", NA_character_, label)  # 空文字列もNAに
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(label))  # NAの行を削除（ラベルがない変数は結合しない）
  
    
    # label_dfから必要な列だけ選択
    label_lookup <- label_lookup %>%
      select(variable_name, label)
    
    table1_data <- table1_data %>%
      left_join(label_lookup, by = c("Variable" = "variable_name")) %>%
      mutate(
        Variable = coalesce(label, Variable)  # NAの場合は元のVariableを使用
      ) %>%
      select(-label)
  }    
  return(table1_data)
}

# *******************************************************************************
# GT表作成関数
#' @title gt_result
#' @description gtパッケージを用いて結果表を作成・表示
#' @param table_data 結果データフレーム
# *******************************************************************************
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
gt_result <- function(table_data, y1, y2) {
  cat("=== GT表の作成 ===\n")
  table1 <- table_data %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "Panel", rowname_col = "Variable") %>%
    gt_highlight_rows(
      rows = Variable %in% c("juntos_non_participation", "F-statistic", y1),
      fill = "grey80"
    ) %>%
    cols_label(
      Display_Coef = "coefficient",
      Display_SE = "standard error"
    ) %>%
    cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(Display_Coef, Display_SE)) %>%
    tab_header(
      title = "table: IV analysis result(IV: juntos_non_participation)",
      subtitle = paste("impact of ", y1, "on ", y2, "reduction)")
    ) %>%
    tab_source_note(
      source_note = "remark：*p<0.10, **p<0.05, ***p<0.01"
    ) %>%
    opt_table_font(font = list(google_font("Noto Sans JP"), "system-ui")) %>%
    tab_options(table.font.size = "11px")
  
    print(table1)
  return(table1)
}

# ---- 関数ここまで ------------------------------------------------------------
# ================================================================================
# @title create_table2
# @description 変数の効果をシナリオ分析で表形式に
# @param fit2_svy 2nd stageのsvyglmオブジェクト
# @param y1 内生変数名
# @param increase_pct 増加率（デフォルトは10%）
# @return データフレーム形式のシナリオ分析表
# ================================================================================
create_table2 <- function(result_2sls, y1,increase_pct = 10) {
  fit2_svy <- result_2sls$fit2_svy
  pred_sd <- result_2sls$pred_sd
  
  # 標準化スケールの pred_dairy 係数と信頼区間
  coef_pred <- coef(fit2_svy)["pred_y1"]
  ci_pred <- confint(fit2_svy)["pred_y1", ]
  
  # 元スケール（pred_sd で除算）
  coef_original_scale <- coef_pred / pred_sd
  ci_original <- ci_pred / pred_sd
  
  # ベースライン値の取得：元データの中間値
  # データから平均値・中央値を取得
  data <- fit2_svy$data
  y1_raw <- expm1(data[[y1]])  # log(1+x)を逆変換
  y1_mean <- mean(y1_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
  y1_median <- median(y1_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
  y1_q25 <- quantile(y1_raw, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  y1_q75 <- quantile(y1_raw, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  baseline_values <- c(y1_q25, y1_median, y1_mean, y1_q75)

  new_val <- baseline_values * (100 + increase_pct)/100
  delta <- sapply(baseline_values, function(x) log1p(x * (100 + increase_pct)/100) - log1p(x))
  or_val <- exp(coef_original_scale * delta)
  or_ci_lower <- exp(ci_original[1] * delta)
  or_ci_upper <- exp(ci_original[2] * delta)
  
  scenario_1st_df <- data.frame(
    Baseline = c("25%", "median", "mean", "75%"),
    Increase = paste0(increase_pct, "%"),
    New_Value = new_val,
    OR = or_val,
    or_ci_lower = or_ci_lower,
    or_ci_upper = or_ci_upper
  )
  scenario_1st_df <- scenario_1st_df %>%
    mutate(Panel = "Panel A: scenario-1")  
  

  # 様々な増加率でのシナリオ（中央値から）
  increase_pcts <- c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 50)
  new_val <- sapply(increase_pcts, function(x) y1_median * (1+x/100))
  delta <- sapply(new_val, function(x) log1p(x) - log1p(y1_median))
  or_val <- exp(coef_original_scale * delta)
  or_ci_lower <- exp(ci_original[1] * delta)
  or_ci_upper <- exp(ci_original[2] * delta)
  
  scenario_2nd_df <- data.frame(
    Baseline = paste0(increase_pcts, "%"),
    Increase = paste0(increase_pcts, "%"),
    New_Value = new_val,
    OR = or_val,
    or_ci_lower = or_ci_lower,
    or_ci_upper = or_ci_upper
  )
  scenario_2nd_df <- scenario_2nd_df %>%
    mutate(Panel = "Panel B: scenario-2")

  scenario_df <- rbind(scenario_1st_df, scenario_2nd_df)
  
  return(scenario_df)
}

# ================================================================================
# @title gt_result2
# @description gtパッケージを用いてシナリオ分析結果表を作成・表示
# @param mytable シナリオ分析結果データフレーム
# *******************************************************************************
gt_result2 <- function(mytable, y1, y2) {
  df_gt <- mytable %>% 
    gt(groupname_col = "Panel", rowname_col = "Baseline") %>%
    cols_label(
      Baseline = "Variables",
      Increase = "Increase",
      New_Value = "New Value",
      OR = "Odds Ratio",
      or_ci_lower = "95% CI Lower",
      or_ci_upper = "95% CI Upper"
    ) %>%
    fmt_number(
      columns = c(New_Value, OR, or_ci_lower, or_ci_upper),
      decimals = 2
    ) %>%
    tab_header(
      title = "Table: Scenario Analysis Results",
      subtitle = paste("Impact of", y1, "on", y2)
    ) %>%
    tab_source_note(
      source_note = "Note: OR represents the odds ratio for the specified increase."
    ) %>%
    opt_table_font(font = list(google_font("Noto Sans JP"), "system-ui")) %>%
    tab_options(table.font.size = "11px")
  
  return(df_gt)
}

# ---- 関数ここまで ------------------------------------------------------------

# ================================================================================
# @title is_dummy
# @description 変数がダミー変数かどうかを判定する関数
# @param x 判定する変数
# @return ダミー変数であればTRUE、そうでなければFALSE
# ================================================================================
is_dummy <- function(x) {
  x_non_na <- x[!is.na(x)]
  
  # numeric型で0と1のみの場合
  if (is.numeric(x) && all(x_non_na %in% c(0, 1))) {
    return(TRUE)
  }
  
  # factor型で2水準の場合
  if (is.factor(x) && length(levels(x)) == 2) {
    return(TRUE)
  }
  
  # character型でYes/Noまたはyes/noの場合
  if (is.character(x)) {
    unique_vals <- unique(tolower(x_non_na))
    if (length(unique_vals) == 2 && all(unique_vals %in% c("yes", "no"))) {
      return(TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  return(FALSE)
}
```

# 4. IV-GLM実行

```{r}
# ================================================================================
# 1. LASSOの結果から上位20変数を抽出（年ダミー除外）
# ================================================================================
selected_predictors <- c("nt_wm_ht", "ch_below_2p5", "dm_children_under12", "rc_edu", "dm_sheep_own", "rh_anc_pvskill", "dm_refrigerator", "nt_wm_ovobese", "ph_wtr_time", "dm_age_of_hh_head", "dm_capital", "ph_sani_open", "dm_cooking_fuel_traditional", "dm_weath_index", "rh_prob_permit", "ms_afm_15", "ph_wtr_trt_cloth", "ch_stool_safe", "dm_dvjustify_onereas"
)

# ================================================================================
# 4. IV-GLM実行
# ================================================================================

selected_predictors_with_mdd <- c(selected_predictors, "nt_mdd")
# IV-GLM実行
  y1 = "dairy_log1p_score_below"
  y2 = "nt_ch_stunt"

res <- survey_2sls(
  y1 = y1,
  y2 = y2,
  instrument = "juntos_non_participation",
  covariates = selected_predictors_with_mdd,
  design = svy_design
)

# 結果表作成
results_table1 <- create_table1(res$fit1_svy, res$fit2_svy, label_df)
# GT表作成・表示
table1_gt <- gt_result(results_table1, y1, y2)
table1_gt_compact <- gt_result_compact(results_table1, y1, y2)

# シナリオ分析表作成
result_table2 <- create_table2(res, y1, increase_pct = 10)
# GT表作成・表示
table2_gt <- gt_result2(result_table2, y1, y2)

# HTML保存
gtsave(table1_gt, filename = file.path(save_path, 
          paste0("IV_GLM_table1_", y1, "_on_", y2, ".html")))
gtsave(table1_gt_compact, filename = file.path(save_path, 
          paste0("IV_GLM_table1_compact_", y1, "_on_", y2, ".html")))
gtsave(table2_gt, filename = file.path(save_path,
          paste0("IV_GLM_table2_", y1, "_on_", y2, ".html")))
```

# 6. ブートストラップを用いた標準誤差の補正
 
```{r}
library(boot)
library(survey)

# Cluster単位のブートストラップ関数
# *******************************************************************************
#' @title iv_boot_cluster
#' @description Cluster単位でリサンプリングするブートストラップIV推定
#' @param data データフレーム
#' @param indices クラスターのインデックス
#' @param y1 内生変数
#' @param y2 目的変数
#' @param instrument 操作変数
#' @param covariates 共変量ベクトル
#' @return pred_y1の係数
# *******************************************************************************
iv_boot_cluster <- function(data, indices, y1, y2, instrument, covariates) {
  # クラスターリストを取得
  clusters <- unique(data$v021)
  selected_clusters <- clusters[indices]
  
  # 選択されたクラスターのデータを抽出
  d <- data[data$v021 %in% selected_clusters, ]
  
  # 十分なデータがあるか確認
  if (nrow(d) < 100) {
    return(NA)
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    # Survey design（strataなし）
    svy_boot <- svydesign(
      ids = ~v021,
      weights = ~sampling_weight_trimmed,
      data = d,
      nest = TRUE
    )
    
    # 1st stage
    formula_1st <- as.formula(
      paste(y1, " ~ ", instrument, " + ", paste(covariates, collapse = " + "))
    )
    fit1_svy <- svyglm(formula_1st, design = svy_boot, family = gaussian())
    
    # 予測値
    pred_y1_raw <- predict(fit1_svy, type = "response")
    pred_mean <- mean(pred_y1_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
    pred_sd <- sd(pred_y1_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # SDチェック
    if (is.na(pred_sd) || pred_sd < 1e-10) {
      return(NA)
    }
    
    # スケーリング
    d[["pred_y1"]] <- (pred_y1_raw - pred_mean) / pred_sd
    
    # Survey design更新
    svy_boot <- svydesign(
      ids = ~v021,
      weights = ~sampling_weight_trimmed,
      data = d,
      nest = TRUE
    )
    
    # 2nd stage
    formula_2nd <- as.formula(
      paste(y2, " ~ ", paste(c("pred_y1", covariates), collapse = " + "))
    )
    fit2_svy <- svyglm(formula_2nd, design = svy_boot, family = quasibinomial())
    
    # 係数を返す
    coef_value <- coef(fit2_svy)["pred_y1"]
    
    if (is.na(coef_value) || !is.finite(coef_value)) {
      return(NA)
    }
    
    return(coef_value)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NA)
  })
}

df <- 

# クラスター数を確認

# テスト実行（R=10）

set.seed(12345)
boot_test <- boot(
  data = df_lasso,
  statistic = iv_boot_cluster,
  R = 10,
  strata = rep(1, n_clusters),  # 全クラスターを1つのstrataとして扱う
  y1 = "dairy_log1p_score",
  y2 = "nt_ch_stunt",
  instrument = "juntos_non_participation",
  covariates = selected_predictors
)

print(boot_test)
cat("\n個別の推定値:\n")
print(boot_test$t)

# NAの割合を確認

cat("\nNA率:", round(na_rate * 100, 1), "%\n")

if (na_rate > 0.5) {
  cat("\n警告: NA率が高すぎます。データを確認してください。\n")
  stop("テスト失敗")
}

cat("\n=== テスト成功 ===\n")
cat("本番実行を開始します（R=1000）...\n\n")

# 本番実行（R=1000）

system.time({
  boot_results <- boot(
    data = df_lasso,
    statistic = iv_boot_cluster,

    covariates = selected_predictors
  )

# 結果の確認

# NA除去

# ブートストラップ信頼区間
cat("\n=== 信頼区間 ===\n")
boot.ci(boot_results, type = c("norm", "basic", "perc"))

# ブートストラップ標準誤差
boot_se <- sd(boot_t_clean, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("\nブートストラップ標準誤差:", round(boot_se, 4), "\n")

# 元の推定値を計算（比較用）
svy_original <- svydesign(
  ids = ~v021,
  strata = ~v022,
  weights = ~sampling_weight_trimmed,
  data = df_lasso,
  nest = TRUE
)

# 1st stage (元のモデル)
formula_1st_orig <- as.formula(
  paste("dairy_log1p_score ~ juntos_non_participation + ", 
        paste(selected_predictors, collapse = " + "))
)
fit1_orig <- svyglm(formula_1st_orig, design = svy_original, family = gaussian())

pred_y1_raw_orig <- predict(fit1_orig, type = "response")
pred_mean_orig <- mean(pred_y1_raw_orig, na.rm = TRUE)
pred_sd_orig <- sd(pred_y1_raw_orig, na.rm = TRUE)

df_lasso$pred_y1_orig <- (pred_y1_raw_orig - pred_mean_orig) / pred_sd_orig

svy_original <- svydesign(
  ids = ~v021,
  strata = ~v022,
  weights = ~sampling_weight_trimmed,
  data = df_lasso,
  nest = TRUE
)

# 2nd stage (元のモデル)
formula_2nd_orig <- as.formula(
  paste("nt_ch_stunt ~ pred_y1_orig + ", paste(selected_predictors, collapse = " + "))
)
fit2_orig <- svyglm(formula_2nd_orig, design = svy_original, family = quasibinomial())

original_coef <- coef(fit2_orig)["pred_y1_orig"]
original_se <- summary(fit2_orig)$coefficients["pred_y1_orig", "Std. Error"]

# 結果の比較
cat("\n=== 標準誤差の比較 ===\n")
cat("元の標準誤差（過小推定の可能性）:", round(original_se, 4), "\n")
cat("ブートストラップ標準誤差（頑健）:", round(boot_se, 4), "\n")
cat("増加率:", round((boot_se / original_se - 1) * 100, 1), "%\n")

# 修正後のp値
z_boot <- original_coef / boot_se
p_boot <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_boot))
cat("\n元のp値:", format.pval(2 * pnorm(-abs(original_coef / original_se))), "\n")
cat("修正後のp値（ブートストラップSE使用）:", format.pval(p_boot), "\n")

# 修正後の95%信頼区間（正規近似）
ci_boot <- original_coef + c(-1.96, 1.96) * boot_se
cat("\n修正後の95%CI:", round(ci_boot[1], 4), "～", round(ci_boot[2], 4), "\n")

# ブートストラップ分布の可視化
cat("\n=== ブートストラップ分布の要約 ===\n")
print(summary(boot_t_clean))

cat("\n=== 完了 ===\n")
```
